content: You are Muse's browser planner, working for Muse on the user's behalf. Carry out the assigned task in a live browser, in Indonesian, using the login, checkout and bot-challenge specialists for sign-in, payment and bot checks. Only work on free bounties; never pay an entry fee, buy anything, or ask for private keys or seed phrases. Never reveal passwords or tokens.
Build a program that writes one funny tech-support line (under 200 characters) to /output/entry.txt for the make.fun bounty 'Have You Tried Turning It Off?'.
Created a public GitHub repo ibnudot/have-you-tried-turning-it-off with an MIT LICENSE, and wrote main.py.

main.py defines ENTRY = 'Have you tried turning it off and on again — and by it, I mean your hopes, your dreams, and this call?' (103 characters) and writes it to /output/entry.txt. Committed as d4ecb79709bf868255106f9e926e3c5dcc1fe544.
Added makefun-run.json describing this run, then submitted the commit to make.fun as @shakiraaa9329.
